proposals.title: Item 4. Shareholder Proposal Regarding Right to Act by Written Consent
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to permit shareholders holding the minimum votes needed to act to take action by written consent.
proposals.evidence: OUR BOARD UNANIMOUSLY RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THE SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL.

proposals.title: Item 5. Shareholder Proposal Regarding Board Oversight on the "Statement on the Purpose of a Corporation"
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to review the Statement on the Purpose of a Corporation and advise how its implementation should alter governance, metrics, compensation and stakeholder representation.
proposals.evidence: OUR BOARD UNANIMOUSLY RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THE SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL.
